data_safety_summary.encryption_in_transit_for_collected_data: N/A for budget data (on-device only). Expo diagnostics use HTTPS.
data_safety_summary.users_can_request_deletion: Delete by clearing app data or uninstalling. No account to delete.

apple_privacy_nutrition_label_guidance.do_not_declare_financial_info_as_collect: Budget entries are on-device only and not sent off device.

play_financial_features_guidance.does_app_include_financial_features: Declare carefully. Flux is a personal budgeting calculator, not banking, payments, loans, investing, or advice.
play_financial_features_guidance.suggested_selection: Other — personal payday / budget calculator; amounts entered by user; no money movement or personalized financial advice.
play_financial_features_guidance.or_if_form_allows: The app does not provide any financial features — only if Play treats pure calculators as none; otherwise use Other with the description above.
